name: prednisolone
basis: Glucocorticoid. On the US label for SLE; EULAR 2023 advises bridging use and minimising maintenance dose.

name: methylprednisolone
basis: Glucocorticoid. EULAR 2023 covers glucocorticoids as bridging therapy.

name: dexamethasone
basis: Glucocorticoid, drug-class evidence. ChEMBL lists phase 4 for SLE.

name: hydroxychloroquine
basis: EULAR 2023 recommends it for all patients with lupus.

name: methotrexate
basis: Immunosuppressant, off-label. Named in EULAR 2023.

name: mycophenolic acid
basis: Active form of mycophenolate. Named in EULAR 2023.

name: azathioprine
basis: Immunosuppressant. Named in EULAR 2023.

name: cyclophosphamide
basis: Named in EULAR 2023.

name: tacrolimus
basis: Calcineurin inhibitor. Named in EULAR 2023.

name: voclosporin
basis: Calcineurin inhibitor. Named in EULAR 2023; two drugs newly approved for lupus nephritis prompted the KDIGO 2024 update.

name: sirolimus
basis: Off-label, small studies only. Not named in the EULAR 2023 abstract.

name: colchicine
basis: For lupus pericarditis only, not lupus as a whole. Case series and a retrospective cohort; benefit unproven.

name: mometasone furoate
basis: Drug-class evidence only: topical corticosteroids are the mainstay for localised cutaneous lupus. No study of this drug checked.

name: diflorasone diacetate
basis: Drug-class evidence only: topical corticosteroids are the mainstay for localised cutaneous lupus. No study of this drug checked.

name: vincristine
basis: Past treatment for refractory lupus thrombocytopenia in a small series. Not named in the EULAR 2023 abstract. 'Historical' is inferred.

name: filgotinib
basis: JAK1 inhibitor. ChEMBL lists phase 2 for lupus; not an established treatment.

name: ruxolitinib
basis: JAK1/2 inhibitor. ChEMBL lists phase 2 for discoid lupus; not an established treatment.

name: baricitinib
basis: JAK1/2 inhibitor. ChEMBL lists phase 3 for SLE; not an established treatment.

name: tofacitinib
basis: JAK inhibitor. ChEMBL lists phase 1 for lupus; not an established treatment.

name: deucravacitinib
basis: TYK2 inhibitor. ChEMBL lists phase 2 for lupus; the project plan records phase 3 under way.

name: atorvastatin
basis: ChEMBL lists phase 3 for SLE. Not a treatment for lupus disease activity (inferred).

name: ixazomib
basis: Proteasome inhibitor. ChEMBL lists phase 1 for lupus nephritis.
